statutoryRightsAndProtection.title: Zero Direct Cost for Lead Replacement (P.L. 2021, c.183)
statutoryRightsAndProtection.summary: Under New Jersey law, the water utility is legally mandated to replace both the public utility-owned portion AND the private customer-owned portion from the curb to the inside water meter. The utility cannot bill the homeowner a direct assessment or capital charge.

statutoryRightsAndProtection.title: Tenant Protection Against Surcharges
statutoryRightsAndProtection.summary: Landlords are required to grant access for lead line replacements. Landlords cannot pass replacement costs onto residential tenants as capital improvement rent surcharges under municipal rent leveling laws.

statutoryRightsAndProtection.title: Free In-Home Lead Water Testing
statutoryRightsAndProtection.summary: Any Clifton property owner or tenant who suspects lead plumbing or has an infant, pregnant resident, or elderly family member can request an official EPA-certified water testing sample bottle from PVWC at zero charge.

statutoryRightsAndProtection.title: How to Do a Scratch Test on Your Incoming Water Pipe
statutoryRightsAndProtection.summary: Locate where the water pipe enters your basement before the meter. Use a key or coin to scratch the pipe: (1) Lead: soft, dull grey, scratches easily to shiny silver, magnets do NOT stick. (2) Copper: color of a penny. (3) Galvanized Steel: hard dull grey, magnet sticks firmly. (4) Plastic/PEX: white, blue, or black flexible tubing.
